passages.context: Cyril's comment on the lemma John 20:1-9 and the opening of his comment on 20:10-11, read in the retrieved transcription between the printed page markers 649 and 651, for his statement that the two disciples inferred the Resurrection from the linen clothes.
passages.notes: Cyril does not mention the soudarion in this comment; his phrase is the bundle of linen clothes. He mentions theft only of Mary's supposition earlier in the same lemma. The last transcribed line is truncated at the printed page break and continues in the source.

work.author: Cyril of Alexandria
work.description: Cyril's commentary on the Fourth Gospel in twelve books. The Greek is incomplete: books seven and eight, covering roughly John 10 to 12, survive only in catena fragments, while book twelve covers John 18 to 21 and includes a continuous exposition of the empty-tomb narrative. A locus is the book number. Edition records keep the Greek, the Library of Fathers English, and dated web deliveries apart.
work.title: Commentary on the Gospel according to S. John
